reasoning:
The profile confirms a binary classification (Survived) with 19.9% missing Age and 77% missing Cabin, plus very high‑cardinality text columns (Name 891 uniques, Ticket 681, Cabin 147). Feature importance shows Age, Fare and the Ticket_grp encoding are strongest, while Title, CabinDeck and family‑size signals are modest but present. Reviewer suggestions point to (1) adding Title and CabinDeck to group‑target encoding with smoothing, (2) smoothing existing Ticket and Cabin encodings, (3) creating FamilySize and IsAlone, (4) adding an Age*Pclass interaction, and (5) keeping frequency encodings for Ticket and Cabin. We therefore:
- Keep the regex extracts Title, TicketPrefix and CabinDeck (they capture useful structure).
- Drop the raw high‑cardinality columns Name, Ticket and Cabin after extraction.
- Log‑transform Fare (high skew 4.79) and keep Age as‑is (moderate skew).
- Frequency‑encode Ticket and Cabin (already useful) and also TicketPrefix to give a rarity signal.
- Add group‑size for TicketPrefix (many passengers share a prefix → family/group size).
- Update group‑target encodings: Ticket and Cabin now use smoothing=7 (mid‑range of reviewer 5‑10); add Title and CabinDeck with smoothing=10. Minimum group size stays 2.
- Add engineered numeric features: FamilySize = SibSp + Parch + 1 and IsAlone = (FamilySize==1). Also Age_Pclass = Age * Pclass.
- Keep missing‑value indicators (default true) and let tree models handle missing Age; no imputation is forced here.
- No datetime columns exist and we do not log‑transform the binary target.
